Kimetsu no Yaiba, also known as Demon Slayer, is not just an action-packed storyline. There are also some inspiring and powerful quotes that might give you the motivation to fight demons. But before we proceed, if you’re looking for more quotes, you can check out the Demon Slayer: Mugen Train quotes! Now, let’s go!

Best Kimetsu no Yaiba Quotes!

Giyu Tomioka Quotes

1. Giyu says this to Tanjiro, because he was actually trying to teach him in that moment. He was trying to teach him to become stronger, that that was what was needed in order for him to be able to save his sister.
(Season 1, episode 15:17)

2. At this point, Giyu had started to see, and believe in Tanjiro. So he pushed on, to make him feel more rage, in order to provoke him to become better. Teachers like this I personally really admire in life. They provide so much motivation, and they do it while making themselves look bad, in order to light a fire under your ass.
(Season 1, episode 16:30)

Inosuke Quotes

1. He’s just hilarious. Kills me with his lines every time. “When you lose to someone smaller than you, it destroys your soul!”
(Season 1, Episode 24, 9:19)

2. Inosuke says that about Tanjiro while they were fighting together to defeat the last being that the mother demon with strings in the forest was controlling. “It’s not about going first for this guy. It’s the battle! It’s the overall flow that he’s watching!”
(Season 1, episode 16, 16:08)

Jigoro Kuwajima Quotes

1. Love this Grandpa. If it wasn’t for him, Zenitsu would never be the absolute OP monster he is, and this is the reason why. Because he drilled into Zenitsu the right principles of success.
(Season 1, episode 17, 13:26)

2. Not this guys was a badass Grandfather, if there ever was one.
(Season 1, episode 17, 13:26)

3. Master one one, or Master of none?
(Season 1, episode 17, 13:26)

Kagaya Ubuyashiki Quotes

1. (Season 1, Episode 23, 21:22)

Makomo Quotes

1. “Train to death. At the end of the day, there is nothing else you can do.”
(Season 1, episode 3, 18:55)

Tamayo Quotes

1. I definitely want to see way more of her. we didn’t get enough. ‘For any kind of wound, there’s always some kind of medicine or treatment.’
(Season 1, episode 8, 18:26)

Tanjiro Kamado Quotes

1. “Don’t wimp out! Save him! Save him! Save him! I”m not powerless anymore! Move!!”
(Season 1, episode 4, 14:38)

2. This was such a great moment, and so devastating. I couldn’t imagine losing someone I loved, the way Kazumi did. Truly an excruciatingly painful thing to happen. “No matter how many people, you may lose, you have no choice but to go on living. No matter how devastating, the blows maybe.”
(Season 1, episode 7, 13:11)

3. Tanjiro says this to Sanemi Shinazugawa (a Hashira) while he head butts him, because he hurt Nezuko.
(Season 1, Episode 22, 10:31)

4. This is actually the first thing Tanjiro says in the beginning of the Anime. Quote frankly what a great quote to start of the anime in my opinion. Such a strong, resolve, conviction, and all bundled with a massive problem to pull in the viewer right away.

5.Tanjjiro to one of the twelve Kizuki, Riu This was one of the best moments. Like where did Tanjiro awaken fire power, when he’s clearly a water breathing style.
(Season 1, episode 19, 21:14)

6. Tanjiro said this to Giyu Tomioka, after he had saved Tanjiro from the father demon.
(Season 1, Episode 21, 10:12)

7. “Work at it. All I can do is work hard! That’s the story of my life! Hard work is some of the other efforts! It can be one step at a time! 
Move forward! right! (Season 1, episode 24, 1:17)

8. “Breathe all the way into my fingertips! Meditation boosts concentration.”
(Season 1, episode 24, 16:47)

9. “No! Because once I’ve mastered it myself, I can teach them, too!”
 (Season 1, episode 24, 17:30)

10. Tanjiro says this to Kanao Tsuyuri, we all remember this don’t we?
(Season 1, episode 26, 15:35)

11. It’s crazy that, Tanjiro, is literally doing affirmations. This is a clear example of personal development and how anime embodies it. “I can do it I know I can do it. I’m the guy who gets it done broken bones or not… No matter what… I can do it! I can fight!”
(Season 1, episode 13, 3:25)

12. “It’s not good! Nothing’s changed at all! Spirit alone isn’t gonna get me anywhere! Your head.. use your head not just your spirit. Think think think.”
(Season 1, episode 13, 4:12)

13. “Look straight ahead. Rouse yourself! Give it all you’ve got Tanjiro! Give it all you’ve got!”
(Season 1, episode 12, 21:00)

14. So true. I recently read in a book called “The Obstacle is the way, that we should never take any enemy head. that should always be the last resort. we should always strive to out-manuever, out-think and out-create our enemies. Having a a head on battle always causes more losses than wins. “Head on battles are simple. Whoever’s stronger and faster wins.”
(Season 1, episode 3, 19:57)

Sabito Quotes

1. This is so true, and I’ve noticed this as a true difference between mastery, of a skill or craft, and people who don’t become masters. knowing something is not the same as embodying it.
(Season 1, episode 3, 15:17)

2. ”Go further! If you’re a man. If you call yourself a man! There’s no other way to go but forward!”

Sakonji Urokodaki Quotes

1. He says this to him, when he first gives Tanjiro the sword. He also tells him that he’ll break his bones if he breaks the sword… LOL. Did you know that in Demon Slayer, the color of the sword has a meaning?

Zenitsu Agatsuma Quotes

1. This was probably my favorite part in the whole anime so far. Zenitsu has hands down one of the best back stories ever….!!!

2. I love the backstory that finally came in regards to Zenitsu. We can finally understand his “wussyness.” It didn’t make sense to me before, but now I get it He is by far my favorite character right now, honestly!

3. “Clearly, Gramps did smack me aroun da bit too much… But he Never abandoned me!”
(Season 1, episode 17, 16:15)

4. This is probably the greatest moment, in anime, itself. Because Zenitsu was just a straight-up Beast he never gave in, he never gave up, he literally give it his all.
(Season 1, episode 17,19:10)

5. “Amazing. Such a great life lesson as well for myself.
(Season 1, episode 17, 12:19)

6. “I won the battle but lost the war!”
(Season 1, episode 24, 9:35)

Yoriichi Tsugikuni Quotes

You’ll feel the gravity of these quotes of Yoriichi once you read the manga. Let’s hope we will also hear him say these in the anime adaptation in the future. But to those who know him, what do you think? Is Yoriichi a demon, and what are his powers?

1. “My brother… we are not that great. We are merely a fragment of humankind’s long, long history. At this moment, those whose talent will surpass ours are uttering their first cries. They may come to reach the same place. There is no need to worry. We can draw the curtain of life closed without unease at any time. Does that not exhilarate you? Brother? Someday… the children now being born will surpass us and ascend… to even greater heights.”
(Demon Slayer Chapter 175)

2. ” I am a man without any value.”
(Demon Slayer Chapter 99)

3. “My dream was to live a quiet life with my family in a small house where we would sleep side by side. I would be close enough to see the beloved faces of my wife and child and close enough to reach out and take their hands. That would have been enough. But even that… did not come true. Demons exist in this beautiful world.”
(Demon Slayer Chapter 186)

4. “I think I was born with special strength for the purpose of defeating Muzan Kibutsuji. But I was lacking. In the end, I failed. Because of that, many more people will die. And that pains me.”
(Demon Slayer Chapter 187)

5. “What is the value of a life to you?”
(Demon Slayer Chapter 187)

Muzan Kibutsuji Quotes

These quotes by Muzan will give you an insight on his visions and philosophy as a demon and will make you taste their dark world. But hold up! Who do you think is the strongest demon in Demon Slayer?

1. “The one thing I hate is “change”. Changes in circumstances. Changes in body. Changes in emotion. In most cases. Every change is “degradation”. It is decline. The one thing I like is “permanence”. If something doesn’t change for an eternity. It’s in a perfect state.” (Demon Slayer Chapter 98)

2. “All that lives must die. Only feelings are eternal and undying. That is true. I do not remember a single human being I have killed. Flesh dies and that is the end. However… their feelings passed on and never fell to ruin and have even defeated me. I have witnessed that fact with my own eyes and I was so moved that I trembled.”
(Demon Slayer Chapter 201)

Conclusion

So, there you have it, folks! The best Demon Slayer quotes of all time. I hope you enjoyed reading it! If you have something in mind, please leave a comment down below. See you soon! But before you leave, you can also read some of Nezuko’s emotional quotes!
